title: Library references
description: Declares the libraries an application or library project depends on. This is the file you edit to add, remove or configure library dependencies; the resolved result is written by the tooling to Libraries.lock.json.

placeholderOverrides.title: Placeholder overrides
placeholderOverrides.description: Redirects placeholder references to a concrete library. Each key is a placeholder name and each value is the library id that should resolve it, overriding the placeholder's default resolution.

defaultSnippets.label: Example placeholder override
defaultSnippets.description: Redirect a placeholder to a concrete library id.

libraryParameters.title: Library parameters
libraryParameters.description: Parameter values passed to parameterized libraries. The outer key identifies the library (a library id, or the relative path for a relative reference); the inner object maps a parameter name to its value.

v3Meta.title: Meta data used by CODESYS V3
v3Meta.description: Free-form metadata carried over from imported CODESYS V3 projects. Omit it for new files.

v3SystemLibraries.title: CODESYS V3 system libraries
v3SystemLibraries.description: System libraries implicitly present in imported CODESYS V3 projects. Free-form; omit it for new files.

references.title: References
references.description: The declared library dependencies. Each key is the name under which the library is referenced in the project; the value describes where the library comes from.

defaultSnippets.label: Example reference
defaultSnippets.description: One managed library referenced by id.

defaultSnippets.label: Example relative path reference
defaultSnippets.description: Reference a library file stored relative to this project.

defaultSnippets.label: Example placeholder reference
defaultSnippets.description: Reference a library indirectly through a placeholder; the concrete library is chosen by resolution.

defaultSnippets.label: Example managed library reference
defaultSnippets.description: Reference a managed library resolved by id from a configured repository.

$type.title: Reference kind
$type.description: How the library is located: RelativePath (a library file stored relative to the project), ManagedLibrary (resolved by id from a configured repository), or Placeholder (resolved indirectly through a placeholder name).

allowUnqualifiedAccess.title: Allow unqualified access
allowUnqualifiedAccess.description: Allow using the library's symbols without their namespace prefix.

publishSymbolsInContainer.title: Publish symbols in container
publishSymbolsInContainer.description: When this project is a container library, re-publish this library's symbols as part of the container.

linkAllContent.title: Link all content
linkAllContent.description: Link every POU of the library, even ones that are never referenced.

optional.title: Optional
optional.description: Do not fail the build if this library cannot be resolved.

path.title: Path
path.description: Location of the library file, relative to this project.

noHash.title: No hash
noHash.description: Skip the integrity-hash check for this relative reference.

libraryId.title: Library id
libraryId.description: Identifier of the managed library to resolve from a configured repository, in the form "Name, Version (Company)".

includePrerelease.title: Include pre-release
includePrerelease.description: Consider pre-release versions when resolving the library.

placeholder.title: Placeholder
placeholder.description: Placeholder name that stands in for the concrete library; the actual library is chosen by the resolution (placeholder overrides, default resolution, or the device).

defaultResolution.title: Default resolution
defaultResolution.description: Library id used to resolve the placeholder when nothing else provides a resolution.

resolverGuid.title: Resolver GUID
resolverGuid.description: Identifier of the resolver responsible for this placeholder. Normally left at the default all-zero GUID.
